ARC Future Fellowships are four-year mid-career research fellowships funded by the Australian Research Council and hosted by Australian universities such as Melbourne. Applications are submitted by the university on the researcher's behalf during scheme rounds announced by the ARC, so prospective applicants should engage their target school or institute first.

Programme Highlights

  • Prestigious four-year fellowship for mid-career researchers
  • Salary plus project support administered via the host university
  • Scheme rounds announced by the ARC with fixed submission dates
  • Pathway into permanent Australian academic positions

Who Should Apply

Researchers typically eight to fifteen years post-PhD with a strong publication record; eligibility rules including Australian residency requirements are set by the ARC guidelines.

Funding and Costs

Four-year fellowship salary plus project funding, administered through the host university per the ARC scheme rules.

Deadline and How to Apply

Contact the research office of the target university (Melbourne's research-funding page lists support), then follow the ARC round timeline when announced. Key deadline information: Scheme rounds run through Australian host universities — calls announced by the ARC.
